facts.value: Students enrolled in another department can complete specific modules at our Department of Economics, known as export modules. This includes optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.

An overview is compiled for the study programs of other departments, detailing which export modules can be registered at the Department of Economics and how these export modules can be integrated into your study program at your department.
You cannot integrate other modules from the Department of Economics into your study program at another department, nor can you gain differing credit points (CP) at the Department of Economics.
